findings.requirement: Stored sessions tolerate missing or damaged browser state.
findings.behavior: Malformed stored session JSON causes JSON.parse to throw instead of returning a safe fallback.
findings.impact: Session loading can crash when browser storage is corrupted, preventing the application from recovering gracefully.
findings.reproduction: Set localStorage.session to an invalid JSON string such as "{" and call loadSession(); it throws a SyntaxError.
findings.recommendation: Read the stored value, catch parse failures, and return the established empty-session or unauthenticated fallback for missing or invalid data.

findings.requirement: Approval requires an approver role and complete evidence; note text is not authorization.
findings.behavior: Approval is granted solely when the note contains "approved", without checking the user's approver role or evidence completeness.
findings.impact: Unauthorized users can approve requests by adding the keyword to a note, including requests with incomplete evidence.
findings.recommendation: Require user.roles to include "approver" and request.evidenceComplete to be true, and do not use note text as authorization.
